advice.description: Exactly one of the two: owner, for a policy question or in doubt, nothing decided; decision, for a build question, decided.

anyOf.description: owner: the question goes to the owner; no record.

reason.description: What makes the question policy, naming the ADR, rule, scope, security boundary or cost limit an option touches. Not empty.

anyOf.description: decision: the record, appended unedited to the project's decisions record.

asked_by.description: Who asked, as the question file states it.

question.description: The question, as the question file states it.

options.description: The options, as the question file states them.

why.description: Why the recorded decisions, or failing them the reasoning stated, exclude it.

rests_on.description: Each recorded decision the answer rests on, as its document and rule or record (e.g. ADR-002 rule 3, D-3, AGENTS.md). The one entry "none" when no recorded decision bears on the question.

follow_ups.description: What the decision leaves to do, one per entry. A follow-up that changes code names the test that proves it.
